draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 88th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 14th of 28 at DE. He went 87th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Sam Hubbard. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 12 sacks in 2021, 5th of 28 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 58 career games and 3 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (95th percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), tackles for loss 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 edge rusher who played: 2.5 sacks against a median of 3.0, below the norm.
